snippet.title: Cherry Tree High Girls' Fight PV
snippet.description:
A training simulator by Atelier 773, Cherry Tree High Girls' Fight puts you in the role of a manager for a team of three girls of your choosing. Train your team to be the strongest through communication topics and rigorous training schedules! 

Coming soon to a PC near you!
